subtitle.running: reads the repository and proposes the team, the resources and the first tasks. Nothing is written until you accept it.
subtitle.done: accept or discard each proposal. Nothing is written until you accept it.
subtitle.empty: an empty directory. Nothing is written until you accept it.
subtitle.none: reads the project and proposes the team, the resources and the first tasks, one by one.

live.title: Reading the repository
live.note: It is a CLI chat with --json-schema: its cost counts in Usage and in the status bar, like any chat's. If there were nothing to read, it would offer the template's team.
live.notePhone: Nothing is written until you accept it. The cost counts in Usage, like any chat's.

wait.team: It will propose the roles {{name}} needs
wait.resources: Agents, skills and commands for this repository
wait.tasks: What is missing, with the why of each one

failed.title: It could not finish
failed.stoppedBody: You stopped it before it answered: it proposed nothing.

empty.title: Nothing to read
empty.body: in <mono>{{path}}</mono>: no files, no chats, no git history. No chat was started.
empty.bodyPhone: <mono>{{path}}</mono> is empty: no files, no chats and no git history. No chat was started, so there is no cost.
empty.teamNote: With nothing to read, it offers the template's team. Accept each role on its own.
empty.tasksIntro: With no code to read, the assistant needs to know what you will build. Say it in one sentence and it proposes the first tasks, each one with its why.
empty.tasksIntroPhone: Tell me what you will build and I will propose the first tasks. You can also create them yourself.
empty.describePlaceholderPhone: A notes app with labels and search…
empty.proposeHint: Opens a CLI chat with <mono>--json-schema</mono>; its cost counts in Usage, like any chat's.
empty.resourcesLater: Once there is code, ask for them from the Resources tab with “Suggest”

none.title: The assistant has not read this project yet
none.body: It opens a CLI chat that only reads the project, and proposes a team, resources and first tasks. You accept each proposal on its own; nothing is written before.

wizard.proposeHint: Once it exists, the assistant reads the project and proposes the team, the resources and the first tasks. You accept each proposal on its own; nothing is written before.
wizard.startFailed: The project was created, but the assistant could not start

teamEmpty.body: Each member is a CLI agent in .claude/agents/, with its role, its model and what it may write, so it also works from the terminal. The assistant reads the project and proposes a team; you accept it member by member.
teamEmpty.foot: Proposing opens a CLI chat that only reads the project

agentry.title: Assistant
agentry.sub: I can tell you how your projects, tasks, orchestrations and usage are doing.

board.title: State of the board
board.ask: What is open on the board, and what is blocked?

orchestrations.title: Orchestrations
orchestrations.ask: Why did the last orchestration fail?

team.title: Flow and team
team.ask: Which cards is the team waiting on?

usage.title: Usage and limits
usage.ask: How much have I spent today?

agentry.placeholder: Ask about projects, tasks, orchestrations or usage…
agentry.greeting: Hi, I'm the Agentry assistant. Ask me about your projects, tasks, orchestrations or usage.
